items.html: And behold, at the death of ZA, up to the upper third of his Tifferet, the posterior of AVI had already descended, but the posterior of Yesh and Tevuna were not completed until the death of the Nukva of ZA. Therefore ZA takes the posterior of AVI, and Malchut takes the posterior of Yesh and Tevuna, and their lights are clothed in them like the Mochin of ZA.
